name: Resource Gathering
desc: Efficiency in collecting and sorting raw materials. Each level increases passive scrap production.

name: Mecha Upgrades
desc: Knowledge of mecha assembly, maintenance, and customization. Each level improves repair speed.

name: Combat
desc: Piloting skill, weapon handling, and defensive maneuvers. Each level improves base ATK.

name: Hacking & Cybernetics
desc: Netrunning, system exploitation, and cyberware integration. Each level generates passive data chip income.

name: Investigation
desc: Analyzing clues, deduction, and uncovering hidden information. Each level accelerates narrative event discovery.

name: Crafting & Research
desc: Fabrication techniques, blueprint analysis, and tech research. Each level speeds up all refinery recipes.

name: Social Influence
desc: Diplomacy, intimidation, and commercial negotiation. Each level gives a bonus to all faction rep gains.
